title: Sony's Disc Decision: Physical Sales Down 87.5%, Data Shows
excerpt: Physical game sales in the US have plummeted 87.5% from their 2009 peak to just 37 million units in the last year. With only seven PlayStation games selling over 100,000 physical copies in 2026, Sony's all-digital shift was inevitable.
